issues.source_value: Fraunhofer IPA TESTED DEVICE certificate for Labsit No. 9123 (color black), report IN 1609-845, ISO 14644-1 class 3 (seat F = 1200N, 12 cycles/min: class 3; backrest F = 350N, 12 cycles/min: class 3; overall class 3). Issued 25 March 2017, validity 5 years -> expired March 2022. Model and article number match the card.
issues.quote: The validity of this certificate | applies only to the mentioned | product in this particular | condition for a duration of | 5 years. ... Stuttgart, March 25, 2017
issues.proposed_card_value: Запросить у BIMOS/IBC Nanotex действующий сертификат Fraunhofer IPA; до получения подписать документ как «Сертификат Fraunhofer IPA (2017, срок действия 5 лет истёк в 2022)» или снять с карточки

issues.card_value: ISO 4 (также в описании «ISO 4 / GMP A-B» и в standards «EN ISO 14644-1 (ISO 4)»)
issues.source_value: Brochure: 'For use in cleanrooms category 3' / 'in accordance with ISO 14644-1' / '(Fraunhofer)' (next two lines). The attached Fraunhofer IPA certificate for Labsit (No.) 9123 (color: black) gives Air Cleanliness Class 3 for seat, backrest and overall result under ISO 14644-1. Class 3 is stricter than the ISO 4 on the card, and the card never states the documented class. Note the certificate itself is expired (see previous issue).
issues.quote: For use in cleanrooms category 3
issues.proposed_card_value: ISO 3 (испытание Fraunhofer IPA, отчёт IN 1609-845, 2017)

issues.card_value: Класс A, B (также «GMP A-B» в описании и «EU GMP A-B» в standards)
issues.source_value: Brochure only says the chair is GMP-conform; no GMP grade (A/B/C/D) is named in any attached document.
issues.quote: GMP-CONFORM | Meets the specifi- | cations of the GMP | regulations
issues.proposed_card_value: Соответствует требованиям GMP (класс помещения GMP производителем не указан)

issues.source_value: 9123 is the non-ESD version. The brochure describes ESD as optional and lists the ESD model separately as 9123E (LABSIT 2-ESD); EN 61340-5-1 is not mentioned in any 9123 document.
issues.quote: electrostatically dissipative (optional)
issues.proposed_card_value: Убрать EN 61340-5-1 из стандартов модели 9123 (ESD-исполнение — артикул 9123E)

issues.source_value: Scanned Fraunhofer IPA certificate for model 9140 of the Basic series, dated 09.12.1999. No validity period is printed, but it is ~27 years old and classifies the chair to Cleanliness Class 1 per US Federal Standard 209E (withdrawn standard), not to ISO 14644-1; ESD per DIN EN 100 015-1 / IEC 61340-5-1. The card's ISO 3 claim remains supported by the current TDS and brochure, but this certificate does not itself state ISO 3.
